You can use an area map to search for near or far weather stations all over the world and have them displayed for detailed diagrams and current readings.

myPWS offers you extensive diagrams with the

• measured values ​​of the current and the previous day
• the last 7 days (per hour / per day)
• any day in the past*

• yearly data*
